sources: Lone Barge (arts unit). Skill 3, sk_wpn_funnel_0015 (rmxlinux Json/SkillData; values from SkillPatchTable at the weapon's skill-3 level: pulse_dmg_up2, max_stack, duration, cd, pulse_dmg_up3, duration2). Its cardAttributeModifier (attribute 52, Electric DMG + pulse_dmg_up) and skills 1-2 stay in the stat panel. Batch-4 report docs/kit-batches/batch-4/chr_0030_zhuangfy.md rows W1-W3.

abilityEvent 208 (the wielder removes a buff) + CheckOriginSkillType [2] (from a battle skill) + CheckBuffIdInContext checkType 1 tag 1474064594 (Arts Reaction, the reaction statuses' parent tag) + CheckTimedMarkerCondition / CreateTimedMarker `cd` (0.1 s) -> buff_wpn_funnel_0015_combo (damageModifier: decorate mask 256, battle skill, and damageTypeMask 8, Electric: NormalCalcZone + pulse_dmg_up; stackingType 2, maxStackCnt from max_stack: layers, each its own `duration`). A consumption by a battle skill's own trigger counts as from a battle skill (the trigger's applications take its cast's kind).

abilityEvent 30 (the wielder casts a skill) + CheckSkillType [7] (ultimate) -> buff_wpn_funnel_0015_ultimate (the same damage modifier with pulse_dmg_up3, for duration2; stackingType 4: refreshed). It starts at the cast, before the ultimate's own effects (Zhuang Fangyi's Empyrean starts 78 frames later, so it outlasts this buff by about 2 s).

Description: "When the wielder's battle skill consumes Arts Reactions, the wielder gains Battle Skill Electric DMG +{pulse_dmg_up2} for {duration}s. Max stacks: {max_stack}. Duration of each stack is counted separately. This effect only triggers once every {cd}s. After the wielder casts an ultimate, the wielder gains Battle Skill Electric DMG +{pulse_dmg_up3} for {duration2}s." (paraphrased from I18nTextTable_EN)

buffs.label: Lone Barge: Battle Skill Electric DMG per consumed reaction
Lone Barge: Battle Skill Electric DMG after an ultimate

triggers.note: Any reaction status (Electrification, Combustion, Solidification, Corrosion) the wielder's battle skill consumes, as Twelve Questions' trigger (wpn_sword_0018); not an infliction.
